nodes.name: Lead form
nodes.notes: POST from the public form via the gateway (/api/lead).

nodes.name: Validate & spam guard
nodes.notes: Honeypot, minimum fill time, link count, field rules, disposable-email block.

nodes.name: Find recent leads
nodes.notes: Same email (any day) or any lead today: feeds the rate limits.

nodes.name: Check limits
nodes.notes: 5 min cooldown per email, 3 per email per day, global daily cap.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ $json.error === 'daily_cap' ? { ok: false, error: 'daily_cap' } : { ok: false, error: 'rate_limited', retry_after_s: $json.retry_after_s } }}

nodes.name: Save lead
nodes.notes: Only a hash of the email is kept here (for rate limits).

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { ok: true, lead_id: $('Validate & spam guard').first().json.lead_id, status_url: '/status?id=' + $('Validate & spam guard').first().json.lead_id } }}

nodes.name: Accepted (202)
nodes.notes: Answer the form right away; the rest runs after the response.

nodes.name: Gemini: qualify lead
nodes.notes: Structured output (JSON schema). 3 tries, 2 s apart.

nodes.name: Gemini: backup model
nodes.notes: Second chance on a lighter model when the main one is busy. Then the rules fallback.

nodes.name: Simulated AI answer
nodes.notes: Only for the 'AI returns broken JSON' demo option.

nodes.name: Check AI answer
nodes.notes: Strict contract check. Anything off-contract falls back to deterministic rules.

nodes.name: HubSpot: upsert contact
nodes.notes: Create or update by email. 3 tries, 2 s apart.

nodes.name: Zoho: upsert lead
nodes.notes: Upsert by email. OAuth2 (Zoho self client): n8n renews the access token on a 401.

nodes.name: HubSpot: add note
nodes.notes: Note with score, reason, red flags and the brief, linked to the contact.

nodes.name: Zoho: add note
nodes.notes: Note on the lead with the score, reason and brief.

nodes.name: Resend: reply to lead
nodes.notes: Idempotency key per lead, so a retry never sends twice.

parameters.errorMessage: ={{ 'Lead ' + $('Validate & spam guard').first().json.lead_id + ': team alert could not be sent' }}

nodes.name: Fail execution
nodes.notes: Marks the execution as failed so the Error Workflow alerts by its own route.
